Messages.Author: Dan Keller
Messages.Body:
I did a quick search on Google but didn't find anything on this, so...

Malkavian Prank
Cardtype: Master
Clan: Malkavian
Master.
Each other Methuselah holds between 1 and 4 <counters> <inclusive> in his or
her hand. Guess the <number of counters> in each Methuselah's hand. If you
guess correctly, you gain that much pool from his or her pool. If you guess
incorrectly, that Methuselah gains that much pool from the blood bank.

Is there anything preventing the Methuselah playing this card from guessing
a number less than 1 or greater than 4?

Dan

as easily inform her of the tactic to begin with and tell her to hold four
and then guess one. That's as good as guessing five.
